title: Patchify and Reconstruct an Image Tensor
summary: Convert channels-first images into ordered patch vectors and reconstruct every input pixel.

runtime.budget_status: actual shared worker caps; per-process address-space limit

physical_contract.axes: B,C,H,W input; H increases down, W right; patches row-major; elements channel then local row then local column.
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: No timestamp input; any temporal or scene alignment is an upstream caller responsibility.
physical_contract.batching: 0<=B<=1024 independent images; 1<=C,H,W,P<=4096 with divisibility. No temporal dimension, resize, crop, or padding.

hidden_case_families: bad divisibility and mismatched image shape

fixtures.source: original synthetic examples in examples.md; future generated fixtures use declared seed

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded teaching contract and explanations; source mechanisms checked against the paired paper card and primary sources; no paper figures or implementation code copied.
